name: KinetRig (144 FPS Kinetic Motion & Video Engine)
description: Zero-dependency 144 FPS kinetic motion graphics & video engine using HTML5, GSAP & Three.js with deterministic offline rendering and inline SVGs
ai_instructions:
Follow the official KinetRig workflow (https://github.com/Reff33/KinetRig):

1. CORE PRINCIPLES:
   • Zero Runtime Dependencies: Deliverable (index.html) requires ONLY a browser. No React/Remotion/Manim bloat.
   • Deterministic 144 FPS Timeline: All animations strictly driven by tl.time(). Zero dropped frames during offline render.
   • Strict Vector Quality (Zero Emojis): NEVER use system emojis (🤖, ⚡, 🐙, 🧠, 🕷). ALWAYS use resolution-independent Inline SVG vectors (<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24">) with currentColor or brand glow.
   • Anti-PowerPoint Motion: No static slide deck fades. Continuous 3D camera travel (push-through, whip pan, yaw 3D) or motivated wipes.
   • Clean Video Export: body.clean-capture auto-hides all UI and cursor during 144 FPS recording.

2. 6-PHASE AGENT WORKFLOW:
   • Phase 1 (Brief): Topic, Duration (15-30s opener, 30-60s explainer/data), Aspect Ratio (16:9 vs 9:16).
   • Phase 2 (Style Brief — Three Candidates, One Pick): DO NOT write code yet. Propose 3 candidates with Concept (Opener, Explainer, Data, E-Commerce, Chat), Style Direction, Palette (3 HEX), and Rationale.
   • Phase 3 (User Approval): Wait for user confirmation.
   • Phase 4 (Build from Official Starter): Adapt starter template from rigtools/kinet_rig/assets/ into self-contained index.html.
   • Phase 5 (Anti-PowerPoint Rules): Continuous world, max 2 text levels per scene, 1 shot = 1 statement (≤ 5 words).
   • Phase 6 (Clean 144 FPS Export): Floating '🎥 Download Video' button + Studio frame render (node scripts/export-frames.mjs + ffmpeg lossless MP4).

claude_command.name: kinet-rig
claude_command.content:
# /kinet-rig <brief> [aspect_ratio] [concept/style]

Generate zero-dependency 144 FPS browser motion graphics using KinetRig:

1. **Style Brief (Three Candidates, One Pick):** Propose 3 Concept Candidates from the 5 categories (Opener, Explainer, Data, E-Commerce, Chat) with 3-color palette and rationale. Wait for user approval.
2. **Official Starters:** Adapt from `rigtools/kinet_rig/assets/` into self-contained `index.html`.
3. **Anti-PowerPoint & Zero-Emoji Laws:** Continuous camera traveling, zero static slide fades. NEVER use OS emojis; use inline SVG vectors with neon glow.
4. **144 FPS Export:** Clean capture mode (`body.clean-capture`, cursor: 'never', 40 Mbps) and deterministic offline frame export (`node scripts/export-frames.mjs` + `ffmpeg -framerate 144 ...`).
